chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Umar ibn Jabala al-Ahmasi, from Abu al-Jaroud, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The ones who love for the sake of Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be upon a land of green emerald, in the shade of His Throne, by His right hand, and both of His hands are right. Their faces will be whiter and more luminous than the rising sun. Every near angel and every sent prophet will envy them for their status. The people will say, 'Who are these?' So it will be said, 'These are the ones who loved for the sake of Allah.'

key_terms.الْمُتَحَابُّونَ فِي اللَّهِ: The ones who love each other for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the status of those who love for the sake of Allah on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This hadith, found in al-Kafi, elaborates on the concept of *al-wala' wa al-bar'* (loyalty and disavement) by highlighting the spiritual rank of those whose bonds are rooted exclusively in divine love. It emphasizes their unique proximity to the Divine Throne (*'Arsh*) on the Day of Judgment, where their radiant countenance and elevated status are recognized by all creation, including prophets and angels. This narrative underscores the Shia understanding that mutual love for Allah's sake is a tangible sign of true faith and a means of attaining high eschatological honor.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Umar Bin Jabala Al Ahmasy, from Abu Al Jaroud, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> said: ‘The ones who love regarding Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, on the Day of Judgement would be upon a land of green emeralds in the Shade of His<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Throne, by His<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Right Hand, and both of His<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Hands are right. Their faces would be intensely white and more illuminating than the emerging sun. Due to their status, they would be the envy of every Angel of Proximity, and every Mursil Prophet<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>. The people would be saying, ‘Who are they?’ So it would be said, ‘They are the ones who loved regarding Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>’’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Muhammad ibn Ali from ‘Umar ibn Jabalah from al-Ahmasi from abu al-Jarud from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Those who love each other for the sake of Allah, on the Day of Judgment will be found on a land of green emerald in the shadow of the Throne to His right - His both hands are right - their faces intensely white and brighter than the shining sun. Every angel close to Allah and every prophet who is a messenger also will envy their position. People will ask, “Who are they?” It will be said, “They are those who loved each other for the sake of Allah.’””
